correctness.rationale: At each root child the centered leaf count defines a rare multinomial category of probability c n^-1/2. A triangular-array characteristic-function CLT yields independent n^1/4 Gaussian fluctuations and equiprobable category permutations. Parity gating constructs any rational limit pair. Fourier inversion and swap coupling give the n^-1/4 lattice mass and asymmetry O(n^-1/2), hence the explicit universal correction. The proof restricts fixed offsets and finite formulas; no universal rate for arbitrary formulas is claimed.
residual_risks: Sharp n^-1/4 law is proved for fixed compatible pair comparisons, not all Boolean formulas.
